## SUMMARY (read aloud at call, ~30 sec)

**20 items, ~10 min review budget (30 sec each).**

- **1 W6-relevant item (#1):** **gu_o005** — Gujarati, VERIFY-FIRST, GT has 3 control chars (Latin "p", "B", "C") mixed into Gujarati. **If user judges GT as corrupted → gu BARRED like ne PDF-tier (no W6 SFT, wrap-only routing). If recoverable → gu SAFE for wrap routing.** This is the ONLY W6-relevant decision in the spot-check.

- **19 confirmation-only items (no decision impact per D3):**
  - 1 ne (PDF-tier BARRED — R5 trust 26.6 already locks)
  - 4 mr (BARRED — visual pass 42.9% already locks)
  - 6 ks (BARRED — visual pass 0%; micro-repair KILLED at K2 default)
  - 8 mni (BARRED — visual pass 0%; GT is sarvam_fill garbage; total capability gap)

**User override options at the call:**
- **"All 20 PASS"** → gt_verification.json updated; user-stamped verification done
- **"gu_o005 BARRED"** → gu moves from VERIFY-FIRST to BARRED per R5-like rule; gu wrapping drops from W6 routing
- **"gu_o005 PASS"** → gu SAFE; becomes a routing target
- **Any individual override** logged in gt_verification.json `human_spot_check_verdicts` field

**Why pipe_danda_ratio column matters:** for ks/sd (Perso-Arabic), pipe_danda_ratio=1.00 means ALL sentence-final punctuation is pipe `|` instead of danda `۔` — a Perso-Arabic font rendering issue, NOT a GT corruption. The high pipe_danda_ratio is consistent across all ks items (6/6). It does NOT change the BARRED status.

**Why short_token_frac column matters:** for ks items, short_token_frac 0.658–0.863 means >65% of tokens are <3 chars (typical Nastaliq fragmentation). This makes CER unreliable as a quality metric (one missing char inflates CER by 30+ pp). The high short_token_frac is why ks is BARRED for W6 SFT — internal CER is meaningless, not because the engine output is wrong.
